name: plebeiangraphlibrary
description: A NetworkX like package for graphs in javascript

scripts.build: rm -rf Build && vite build && vite build --mode standalone
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run document
scripts.document: rm -rf docs && npx typedoc --options typedoc.json && cp graph_animation.gif docs/
scripts.document:public: npm run document && rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && cp -R docs/. public/
scripts.examples:public: rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && cp -R Examples/. public/
scripts.deploy:public: npm run build && npm run document && rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && mkdir -p public/Build && cp -R Build/. public/Build/ && cp -R Examples/. public/ && cp -R docs/. public/ && cp favicon.ico public/ && touch public/.nojekyll
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:performance && npm run build && npm run test:visual && npm run test:examples

author: Indrajeet Haldar
